scope: whole command, including startup/loading/prefill/checks; not decode-only or per-token energy

process.output:
usage: autoregressive_bench.py [-h] [--engine {native,torch}]
                               [--context CONTEXT]
                               [--decode-steps DECODE_STEPS]
                               [--warmups WARMUPS] [--repeats REPEATS]
                               [--batches BATCHES] [--seed SEED] --output
                               OUTPUT

Native/PyTorch autoregressive decode, sharing the vLLM prompt and fixed
length. Wall timing starts with the prefill token ready and ends with output
IDs on CPU. Loading, prefill, cache restoration and numerical qualification
are excluded.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --engine {native,torch}
  --context CONTEXT
  --decode-steps DECODE_STEPS
  --warmups WARMUPS
  --repeats REPEATS
  --batches BATCHES
  --seed SEED
  --output OUTPUT

timestamp_basis: host monotonic receipt; sensor update phase and transport delay are not calibrated
attribution: Total observed rail consumption, including other workloads; no idle subtraction
note: This command only printed help; GPU energy zero is not a native inference measurement.
